signals.title_ko: 반도체 수출 163.9% 급증, 3월 1~20일 역대 최대 수출 533억 달러 기록
signals.title_en: Semiconductor Exports Surge 163.9%, Record $53.3B in March 1-20
signals.summary: Korea's semiconductor exports jumped 163.9% YoY in the first 20 days of March 2026, reaching $18.7B. Total exports hit a record $53.3B for the period, driven by AI infrastructure investment and HBM demand. Semiconductors now account for 35% of total exports.

signals.title_ko: 미국 무역법 301조 조사 개시 — 한국 포함 16개국 대상
signals.title_en: US Initiates Section 301 Trade Investigation Targeting Korea Among 16 Economies
signals.summary: USTR officially launched Section 301 investigations on March 11, targeting Korea among 16 economies. The probe covers automobiles, steel, semiconductors, shipbuilding, chemicals, and machinery. The Trump administration aims to complete the investigation by late July 2026, with additional tariffs possible. Korea's manufacturing sector, which accounts for 84% of total exports, faces significant risk.
signals.tipping_point_reason: Could trigger cascading supply chain restructuring and accelerate Korea's trade diversification away from the US

signals.title_ko: 노란봉투법 3월 10일 시행 — 노동시장 격변 예고
signals.title_en: Yellow Envelope Law Takes Effect March 10, Heralding Labor Market Upheaval
signals.summary: Korea's Yellow Envelope Law (amended Trade Union Act) took effect on March 10, expanding the legal definition of 'employer' to include principal contractors with substantial control over subcontracted workers. The law limits excessive corporate damage claims against union activities. Business groups warn of potential operational paralysis as multiple subcontractor unions could simultaneously demand negotiations with a single principal contractor.
signals.tipping_point_reason: Could fundamentally reshape Korea's subcontracting labor structure and trigger corporate automation/offshoring responses

signals.title_ko: 한국 AI 기본법 세계 최초 시행 — 고영향 AI 규제 체계 가동
signals.title_en: Korea Becomes World's First to Implement AI Basic Law — High-Impact AI Regulation Framework Activated
signals.summary: Korea became the world's first nation to implement a comprehensive AI Basic Law on January 22, 2026. The law mandates AI usage disclosure (up to KRW 30M penalty for non-compliance), establishes a risk management framework, and creates a National AI Committee as the top governance body. A grace period of at least one year for enforcement penalties is in place, with government focusing on consulting and awareness first.
signals.tipping_point_reason: Sets global precedent for AI governance; could influence international regulatory frameworks and AI industry development patterns

signals.title_ko: 중동 긴장 고조로 유가 100달러 재돌파, 소비자심리 급락
signals.title_en: Middle East Tensions Push Oil Past $100, Consumer Sentiment Plunges
signals.summary: Brent crude oil has re-crossed the $100 mark amid US-Iran military tensions and Strait of Hormuz instability. Korea's Consumer Confidence Index (CCSI) fell 5.1 points to 107.0, the sharpest decline since the December 2024 martial law incident. Korea imports 60-70% of its helium gas from Qatar, critical for semiconductor manufacturing, raising supply chain concerns.
signals.tipping_point_reason: Sustained $100+ oil could trigger inflationary spiral in energy-dependent Korean economy and disrupt semiconductor supply chains

signals.title_ko: 이재명 대통령 지지율 취임 후 최고 69% 기록
signals.title_en: President Lee Jae-myung Approval Rating Hits Post-Inauguration High of 69%
signals.summary: President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating reached a post-inauguration high of 69%, with positive assessments of economic, welfare, and housing policies. The Democratic Party leads with 53% support vs. People Power Party at 28.1%. The June 3 local elections are projected as a strong ruling party victory (58.3% expect ruling party win).

signals.title_ko: 2026년 1월 출생아 수 전년 대비 21.2% 급감, 121개월 연속 감소
signals.title_en: January 2026 Births Plunge 21.2% YoY, 121 Consecutive Months of Decline
signals.summary: The number of births in January 2026 was 2,348, a 21.2% plunge from the previous year's 2,981, marking 121 consecutive months of decline and a record low. The total fertility rate stands at 0.62. However, 2025 saw a 6.6% increase in total births to 258,242, suggesting a possible inflection point. Deaths rose 2.4% YoY to 29,123.
signals.tipping_point_reason: Structural demographic crisis with cascading effects on labor market, pension systems, military capacity, and economic growth potential

signals.title_ko: 정년연장 65세 입법 본격 추진 — 여야 법안 경쟁
signals.title_en: Retirement Age Extension to 65 Gains Legislative Momentum — Rival Party Bills Compete
signals.summary: The National Human Rights Commission recommended extending the statutory retirement age, and the government confirmed plans to pursue phased legislative action. The Democratic Party proposed three options with full implementation by 2036-2041, combining mandatory extension with 1-2 year re-employment. The People Power Party countered with industry-specific differential retirement ages. Both labor and management oppose the current proposals.
signals.tipping_point_reason: Will fundamentally restructure Korea's labor market, pension system, and intergenerational employment dynamics

signals.title_ko: 에이전틱 AI 원년 — 한국 기업 24% 이미 도입
signals.title_en: Year of Agentic AI — 24% of Korean Firms Already Adopted
signals.summary: About 24% of Korean enterprises have already adopted agentic AI systems that autonomously make decisions and execute tasks. Korea's AI spending is projected to reach $7.1B by 2028. The shift from passive AI tools to autonomous agents is transforming workflows across manufacturing, logistics, and customer service. Physical AI combining robotics with AI intelligence is entering commercialization.
signals.tipping_point_reason: Agentic AI represents a paradigm shift from tool-based to autonomous AI, potentially displacing knowledge workers at scale

signals.title_ko: 정부 AI R&D에 5.5조원 역대 최대 투자 — 전년비 18% 증액
signals.title_en: Government Allocates Record KRW 5.5T for AI R&D, Up 18% YoY
signals.summary: The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy is investing a record KRW 5.5 trillion in technology R&D in 2026, with KRW 1.045 trillion specifically for industrial AI expansion (up 52%). Focus areas include AI factories, physical AI, and new project support increased 85% to KRW 1.4 trillion. This signals the government's commitment to maintaining Korea's AI competitiveness.

signals.title_ko: 원달러 환율 1,500원 돌파 — 2009년 이후 최저 수준
signals.title_en: KRW/USD Breaches 1,500 — Weakest Since March 2009
signals.summary: The Korean won has weakened past 1,500 per dollar, reaching its lowest level since March 2009. The depreciation is driven by Middle East geopolitical tensions, rising oil prices, and global risk-off sentiment. The KOSPI benchmark fell 6.49% in a single session to 5,406, tracking sharp regional selloffs.

signals.title_ko: G7 중동 긴장 완화 및 에너지 안보 공동성명 발표
signals.title_en: G7 Issues Joint Statement on Middle East De-escalation and Energy Security
signals.summary: G7 foreign ministers issued a joint statement on March 21 condemning Iran-backed attacks, affirming support for Middle East partner nations, and committing to secure the Strait of Hormuz and other critical shipping routes. The statement endorsed IEA member states' strategic petroleum reserve releases and demanded Iran halt its ballistic missile program.

signals.title_ko: KOMCA, AI 작곡곡 저작권 등록 전면 금지
signals.title_en: KOMCA Bans Copyright Registration for AI-Composed Music
signals.summary: The Korea Music Copyright Association (KOMCA) implemented a complete ban on copyright registration for AI-composed songs effective March 24. New registrations now require certification that no AI was used in composition or lyrics. This does not cover AI use in production/recording stages. The Korean Board of Audit found that 60.9% of music receiving royalties in 2024 may have involved AI.
signals.tipping_point_reason: Sets precedent for how creative industries manage AI; the 60.9% figure suggests AI's creative role is already pervasive and uncontainable

signals.title_ko: 이재명 정부 초강력 부동산 정책 예고 — 농지 전수조사, 강제매각 검토
signals.title_en: Lee Government Signals Ultra-Strong Real Estate Policy — Comprehensive Farmland Survey, Forced Sales Under Review
signals.summary: The Lee Jae-myung administration announced plans for comprehensive farmland surveys and potential forced sales of speculative holdings, alongside expanded regulation zones and stricter transaction reporting. The government also expanded Buttimok jeonse loan eligibility to reconstruction tenants. These measures aim to curb real estate speculation while supporting tenants amid a shift to a tenant-centered market.

signals.title_ko: 양자산업 육성법 실행 단계 돌입 — 5개 양자클러스터 공모 개시
signals.title_en: Quantum Industry Promotion Act Enters Implementation — 5 Quantum Clusters to Be Designated
signals.summary: Korea's Quantum Science and Technology Industry Promotion Act entered implementation in 2026, with the government launching public solicitation for 5 quantum clusters from March to July, with final designation in August. The clusters will receive differentiated national funding over 5 years (2026-2030). Annual quantum workforce training of 100 specialists begins in 2026.

signals.title_ko: 재생에너지 100GW 목표 — 태양광 규제 개선 및 석탄발전 2040년 전환
signals.title_en: 100GW Renewable Energy Target — Solar Regulation Reform and 2040 Coal Phase-Out Roadmap
signals.summary: The government announced a 100GW renewable energy deployment target by 2030, with legislative reforms to ease solar panel setback regulations and a special law for agrivoltaic systems. A 12th Basic Electricity Supply Plan and 2040 coal power transition roadmap are being developed. The K-GX (Korea Green Transformation) strategy aims for fundamental restructuring of industrial and economic systems.

signals.title_ko: 1인 가구 42% 도달 — 싱글 이코노미 가속화
signals.title_en: Single-Person Households Reach 42% — Solo Economy Accelerating
signals.summary: Single-person households now represent 42% of all Korean households and are projected to continue growing. This is accelerating the 'single economy' across food, housing, entertainment, and retail. The trend is linked to delayed marriage, rising elderly population living alone, and changing attitudes toward independent living.

signals.title_ko: 트렌드 코리아 2026: AI와 인간 본질 사이의 균형 — '픽셀라이프', '근본니즘'
signals.title_en: Trend Korea 2026: Balance Between AI and Human Essence — 'Pixel Life' and 'Fundamentalism'
signals.summary: Trend Korea 2026 identifies two major axes: AI's pervasive impact on society, and a counter-movement toward human authenticity. 'Pixel Life' describes micro-consumption patterns of brief, fragmented engagement. 'Fundamentalism' (Geunbon-nism) describes a return to timeless values, tradition, and analog experiences as a response to digital fatigue. 'Ready Core' emphasizes preparedness as a life attitude.

signals.title_ko: 국산 AI 반도체(NPU) 스마트시티 실증 본격화
signals.title_en: Domestic AI Semiconductor (NPU) Smart City Deployment Begins in Earnest
signals.summary: Korea is deploying domestically developed NPU (Neural Processing Unit) chips in smart city environments, marking a strategic shift from GPU-dependent AI infrastructure toward low-power, high-efficiency NPU-centered technology sovereignty. The initiative covers traffic management, public safety, and urban services, establishing a domestic AI semiconductor ecosystem.

signals.title_ko: 한국 제조 로봇 밀집도 세계 1위 — 근로자 1만명당 1,012대
signals.title_en: Korea Ranks #1 Globally in Manufacturing Robot Density — 1,012 per 10,000 Workers
signals.summary: Korea maintains the world's highest manufacturing robot density at 1,012 robots per 10,000 workers. The global robot market is estimated at KRW 435 trillion in 2025 and is projected to grow 20-25% annually as AI integration deepens. KG Mobility signed an MOU with KIMM and ETRI for AI humanoid robot development. Automakers are introducing AI robots that could reshape factory operations.

signals.title_ko: 지방선거 여론조사: 여당 승리 전망 58.3% — 6월 3일 실시
signals.title_en: Local Election Polls: 58.3% Expect Ruling Party Victory — June 3 Vote
signals.summary: Polls show 58.3% of Koreans expect a ruling party victory in the June 3 local elections, versus 23.1% expecting an opposition win. Support for the ruling Democratic Party stands at 57.7% vs. 35.0% for the opposition in election framing. Even among moderates, 68.4% predict a ruling party win, signaling potential dominance across all levels of government.

signals.title_ko: 디지털 피로와 아날로그 복귀 현상 확산
signals.title_en: Digital Fatigue and Analog Resurgence Spreading Across Korean Society
signals.summary: An increasing number of Koreans are engaging in 'digital decluttering' — deleting unused social media apps, silencing notifications, and returning to analog activities. Homecraft (sewing, knitting, pottery) is surging as people seek emotional stability through tactile creation. This represents a counter-trend to AI saturation, with implications for the tech, retail, and wellness industries.

signals.title_ko: KDI 3월 경제동향: 한국 경제 2.0% 성장 전망 유지
signals.title_en: KDI March Economic Trends: Korea's 2.0% Growth Forecast Maintained
signals.summary: KDI released its March economic trends report maintaining Korea's 2026 growth forecast at approximately 2.0%, supported by semiconductor export strength and gradual consumption recovery. Bank of Korea projects 2.0% growth as well, despite US tariff impacts and slow construction investment recovery. Consumer inflation is expected at 2.0% with the base rate at 2.5%.

signals.title_ko: 테크 위켄드 2026: 양자 알고리즘부터 AI 의료까지 딥테크 혁신
signals.title_en: Tech Weekend 2026: Deep Tech Innovation from Quantum Algorithms to AI Healthcare
signals.summary: Tech Weekend 2026 convened global deep tech startups in Seoul, showcasing innovations spanning quantum algorithms, AI-powered medical diagnostics, and advanced materials. The event connected startups with investors, reflecting Korea's growing role as a deep tech hub. Quantum computing, bio-AI convergence, and climate tech were highlighted as breakthrough areas.

signals.title_ko: 2026 서울 기후 컨퍼런스 개최 — 정책·기술·금융 연결 실행 플랫폼
signals.title_en: 2026 Seoul Climate Conference Launched — Policy-Technology-Finance Execution Platform
signals.summary: The 2026 Seoul Climate Conference positioned itself as an execution platform connecting climate policy, technology innovation, and finance. Experts presented climate tech strategies for carbon neutrality, emphasizing that 2026 is the year 'provable execution' replaces 'ambitious vision' as the evaluation standard for corporate sustainability.

signals.title_ko: 지속가능성 3대 트렌드: AI 기반 ESG, 순환경제, 생물다양성 공시 의무화
signals.title_en: Three Sustainability Megatrends: AI-Driven ESG, Circular Economy, Biodiversity Disclosure Mandates
signals.summary: Three sustainability megatrends for 2026: AI-driven sustainability management becoming operational infrastructure; circular economy and digital product passports gaining regulatory traction; and mandatory biodiversity impact disclosure starting in 2026. Korean companies must develop comprehensive response strategies across all three areas.

signals.title_ko: 무상교육·보육 지원 4세까지 확대
signals.title_en: Free Education and Childcare Support Extended to Age 4
signals.summary: Starting March 2026, the government expanded free education and childcare support from age 5 down to age 4, as part of national responsibility-type early childhood education. This policy aims to reduce parental childcare costs and address the structural low birth rate by easing the financial burden of raising young children.

signals.title_ko: 개인정보보호법 개정 — 사후 제재에서 AI·데이터 활용 신뢰 인프라로 전환
signals.title_en: Personal Information Protection Act Reformed — From Post-Sanctions to AI/Data Trust Infrastructure
signals.summary: Korea's reformed Personal Information Protection Act shifts from a post-sanction enforcement model to a proactive investment-promotion framework that serves as trust infrastructure for AI and data utilization. This represents a fundamental regulatory philosophy change, aiming to balance privacy protection with enabling AI innovation.

signals.title_ko: 물리적 AI(Physical AI) 시대 본격 개막
signals.title_en: Physical AI Era Officially Begins — AI Beyond Digital Into Physical Interaction
signals.summary: 2026 marks the beginning of the Physical AI era, where AI interacts directly with the physical world through robotics and IoT. This extends AI capabilities from digital-only to tangible real-world applications in manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, and daily life. Korean companies are investing in humanoid robots and autonomous systems as the next frontier.
signals.tipping_point_reason: Convergence of AI with physical systems could fundamentally transform labor markets, urban infrastructure, and human-machine interaction

signals.title_ko: 2026 글로벌 트렌드: 포퓰리즘, 분쟁 일상화, AI 버블 우려
signals.title_en: 2026 Global Trends: Populism, Normalized Conflict, AI Bubble Concerns
signals.summary: KDI identified 7 global trends across politics, military/diplomacy, economy, society, and industry/technology: the age of populism; disappearing peace and normalized conflict; changing global economic formulas; growing capital market crisis potential; weakening global middle-class consumption; 'AI — reality or illusion?'; and rising digital asset markets.

signals.title_ko: 한미 관세 협상 후 추가 압박 — 25% 관세 인상 위협
signals.title_en: Post-Agreement US Tariff Pressure — Threat of 25% Rate Hike
signals.summary: Despite the October 2025 US-Korea tariff agreement (Korea to invest $350B in US, purchase $100B in LNG, 15% tariff rate), Trump threatened to raise tariffs from 15% to 25% in January 2026, citing Korea's National Assembly failure to pass a special investment management bill. The November 2026 US midterm elections add further uncertainty to bilateral trade dynamics.

signals.title_ko: 서울시 AI 행정혁신 2.0 추진 — 디지털 도시 전략
signals.title_en: Seoul City Launches AI Administrative Innovation 2.0 — Digital City Strategy
signals.summary: Seoul Metropolitan Government is advancing AI Administrative Innovation 2.0, integrating AI across city services, transportation, and safety management. The Seoul Smart Life Week (SLW) 2026 will showcase citizen-facing AI applications. This reflects a broader trend of city-level AI governance becoming a testing ground for national digital transformation.

signals.title_ko: 인구정책 구조적 전환 — 출산율 제고에서 삶의 질·제도 개혁으로
signals.title_en: Demographic Policy Structural Shift — From Birth Rate Boosting to Quality of Life and Institutional Reform
signals.summary: KDI recommends a fundamental shift in population policy from short-term birth rate targets to long-term structural reform focused on quality of life, individual choice, and regional balance. After 20+ years and trillions in spending on pro-natalist policies with minimal results, the policy paradigm is finally acknowledging that demographic decline requires adaptation rather than reversal.
signals.tipping_point_reason: Represents a paradigm shift from futile birth-rate-boosting to societal adaptation, potentially reshaping immigration, labor, pension, and welfare policies

signals.title_en: KOSPI Monthly Swing -5.0%, Range 5,059-6,347
signals.summary: The KOSPI index has shown extreme volatility over the past month, swinging between a high of 6,347 and a low of 5,059, with a net monthly decline of 5.0%. The benchmark fell 6.49% in a single session amid Middle East tensions. High volatility reflects compounding risks from geopolitical tensions, trade uncertainty, and shifting monetary policy expectations.

signals.title_ko: 정부 저작권법 공정이용 AI 학습 기준 안내서 발간
signals.title_en: Government Publishes Fair Use Guidelines for AI Training on Copyrighted Works
signals.summary: The Ministry of Culture and Korea Copyright Commission published guidelines on how copyright law's 'fair use' provisions apply to AI training data. The guide specifies conditions under which copyrighted works can be used without permission for AI learning. This provides a regulatory framework balancing creator rights with AI innovation needs.

signals.title_ko: 열에너지 혁신 로드맵 3월 발표 예정 — 히트펌프 중심 건물 탈탄소화
signals.title_en: Thermal Energy Innovation Roadmap Due March — Heat Pump-Centric Building Decarbonization
signals.summary: The government is set to release a Thermal Energy Innovation Roadmap in March 2026, centered on heat pump expansion for building decarbonization. This aligns with the broader 100GW renewable energy target and K-GX strategy, representing a concrete step in Korea's energy transition from fossil-fuel heating to electrified thermal systems.
